name: Business Bootcamp (free online workshops for high schoolers)
org: New York Institute of Technology (New York Tech), School of Management
what_you_do: Join a one-hour workshop on Zoom, like a college class. Business teachers lead it. Topics include money skills, buying stocks or real estate, a plan to market yourself, and job interviews.
who_can_apply: Any high school student interested in any major. Go to one session or all of them.
pay_detail: Free. You get a certificate of completion for each session you attend.
duration: One hour per session, 7 to 8 pm
deadline_text: Page lists sessions (years not printed, likely 2026): Oct 20 Financial Literacy; Nov 17 Investing and Strategic Planning; Dec 15 Standing Out in a Job Interview. Register for each session separately.
how_to_apply: Use the register link for each session on the Business Bootcamp page. Sessions run on Zoom.
notes: The page did not print the year next to the session dates, so check the dates when you sign up. A search summary named a separate High School Business Academy in Manhattan. Its page was not read and its cost is unknown.
